text:
-- Step 8: Two lenses, two verdicts: disagreement is expected and auditable 
  EU lens:    reading evidentiary; freshness fresh; coverage 3/3; trust
               log-anchored; outcome PASS
  JP lens:    reading evidentiary; freshness fresh; coverage 2/3; trust
               log-anchored; outcome DEGRADED (coverage-incomplete, missing
               ["ferin:jp/de.jp.top-runner-class@2026.1"])
  divergence: the same passport passes the EU lens and degrades under the
               JP lens because the top-runner-class data point is not yet
               provided; both verdicts stand side by side, neither overrides
               the other
  note:       Single definition, many constraints: profiles constrain and
               transform, never redefine; inter-profile disagreement is
               resolved to canonical facts plus the rules of each lens,
               never to one true classification, and coverage reports make
               the gap explicit (I2, I9).
